title: Trial when legal title in controversy.
bodyText: Whenever in an action brought under this chapter the legal title is in controversy, the issue shall be triable of right by a jury.
bodyHtml: §669-3.5  Trial when legal title in controversy.  Whenever in an action brought under this chapter the legal title is in controversy, the issue shall be triable of right by a jury. [L 1972, c 90, §12(d)]
